boundary: Synthetic issued-drift processor and PostgreSQL correction-review lifecycle; controlled provider, not HTTP/signing or manual resolver parity.
preserved_rows_sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('credentials',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.issued_credentials c),'transactions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.issuance_transactions t))
snapshot_sql:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM issuance_service.evidence_facts),
 'head_scores',(SELECT jsonb_agg(f.assertion::jsonb->'score_percent' ORDER BY h.logical_key) FROM issuance_service.evidence_fact_heads h JOIN issuance_service.evidence_facts f ON f.id=h.fact_id),
 'reviews',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'status',r.status,'prior_allowed',r.prior_decision::jsonb->'allowed',
   'current_allowed',r.current_decision::jsonb->'allowed',
   'triggering_score',f.assertion::jsonb->'score_percent',
   'action',r.resolution_action,'resolved_by',r.resolved_by,
   'resolved_at_present',r.resolved_at IS NOT NULL,
   'claim_token',r.resolution_claim_token,'claim_action',r.resolution_claim_action,
   'recovery_pending',r.resolution_recovery_pending) ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id)
   FROM issuance_service.evidence_policy_reviews r JOIN issuance_service.evidence_facts f ON f.id=r.triggering_fact_id),'[]'::jsonb),
 'events',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(event_type,n),'{}'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT event_type,count(*) n FROM issuance_service.issuance_events GROUP BY event_type) e),
 'application',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('status',status,'credential_id',credential_id,'policy_allowed',integration_context::jsonb->'canvas'->'last_evidence_policy_allowed') FROM issuance_service.applications WHERE id='application-review'),
 'credential',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'active',bool_and(status='active' AND revoked=false)) FROM issuance_service.issued_credentials)
 )
